fixedWording.creditDecisionBeforeOffers: Approval and rates come from the lender's soft check, not from me. The check returns her actual offers, if there are any.
fixedWording.creditDecisionAfterOffers: The offers on screen are what the lender's check returned. Approval and rates come from the lender, so I can't say more about her credit.
fixedWording.offTopic: I can only help with the financing for this project. For tax, legal or other questions, she should ask the right professional.
fixedWording.noOffers: No offers came back from this check. The lender will send the homeowner a notice explaining why, and I can't say more about it.
